set-variable.name: requested-model
set-variable.value: @{ if (context.Request.Body == null) { return context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault("deploymentId", string.Empty); } var body = context.Request.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); var model = body.GetValue("model", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)?.ToString(); if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(model)) { model = context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault("deploymentId", string.Empty); } return model ?? string.Empty; }

set-variable.name: semantic-cache-key
set-variable.value: @{ var subscriptionId = context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : "anonymous"; var model = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requested-model", "default"); var requestBody = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("request-body-json", string.Empty); var hash = Convert.ToBase64String(System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create().ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(subscriptionId + ":" + model + ":" + requestBody))); return "semantic-cache:" + hash; }

set-variable.name: selected-backend
set-variable.value: @{ var requestedModel = ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requested-model", string.Empty)).ToLowerInvariant(); var routing = JArray.Parse((string)context.Variables["routing-config"]); var candidates = routing.Children<JObject>().Where(entry => !entry["models"].Any() || entry["models"].Any(model => string.Equals(model.ToString(), requestedModel, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))).OrderBy(entry => (int?)entry["priority"] ?? 100).ToList(); if (!candidates.Any()) { candidates = routing.Children<JObject>().OrderBy(entry => (int?)entry["priority"] ?? 100).ToList(); } if (!candidates.Any()) { return string.Empty; } var pick = Math.Abs(context.RequestId.GetHashCode()) % candidates.Count; return candidates[pick].ToString(); }

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", "BackendUnavailable"), new JProperty("message", "No Azure OpenAI backend was configured for the requested model.")))).ToString(); }

inbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "gateway-routing", model = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requested-model", string.Empty), selectedBackend = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend-name", string.Empty), estimatedTokens = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("estimated-token-count", 0), subscriptionId = context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : string.Empty, productId = context.Product != null ? context.Product.Id : string.Empty }; }

set-variable.name: prompt-tokens
set-variable.value: @{ if (context.Response == null || context.Response.Body == null) { return 0; } var responseBody = context.Response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); var usage = responseBody.GetValue("usage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase); return usage == null ? 0 : (int?)usage["prompt_tokens"] ?? 0; }

set-variable.name: completion-tokens
set-variable.value: @{ if (context.Response == null || context.Response.Body == null) { return 0; } var responseBody = context.Response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); var usage = responseBody.GetValue("usage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase); return usage == null ? 0 : (int?)usage["completion_tokens"] ?? 0; }

set-variable.name: total-tokens
set-variable.value: @{ if (context.Response == null || context.Response.Body == null) { return 0; } var responseBody = context.Response.Body.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true); var usage = responseBody.GetValue("usage", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase); return usage == null ? 0 : (int?)usage["total_tokens"] ?? 0; }

outbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "token-usage", model = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requested-model", string.Empty), backend = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend-name", string.Empty), subscriptionId = context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : string.Empty, promptTokens = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("prompt-tokens", 0), completionTokens = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("completion-tokens", 0), totalTokens = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("total-tokens", 0), estimatedTokens = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("estimated-token-count", 0) }; }
